summary.zh: 按钮有一层实体「底座」，按下时 70ms 快速沉到底，松手用带过冲的弹簧曲线弹回来，再炸出一圈短线。
summary.en: A button with a solid base: it sinks in 70ms on press, springs back with an overshooting curve on release, and bursts a ring of short rays.

technique.zh: 按下和松开用两条不同的 transition：按下 ease-out 很快，松开 cubic-bezier(.3,1.9,.5,1) 过冲回弹；放射线是 8 根 i，rotate(k×45deg) translateY 往外飞。
technique.en: Two different transitions: press is a quick ease-out, release uses cubic-bezier(.3,1.9,.5,1) to overshoot; the burst is 8 <i> rays at rotate(k×45deg) flying outward.

desc.zh: 回弹曲线，第二个值越大越弹

adapt.zh: 真实点击直接靠 :active，不用 JS；JS 只负责放射线和演示里的自动按。
adapt.en: Real presses rely on :active alone; JS only adds the burst and the demo autoplay.
